scope.original_project_license: No new blanket license for original project code or procedural assets is assigned by this asset audit. Third-party conditions remain scoped to their respective photos and derivatives.

omission_effects: Official reference-only photos, booklet PDF/page images and future-completion illustration are not distributed. Their descriptions and source URLs remain in the source ledgers.

Unselected search candidates, cached third-party HTML, research queues, old model previews, optional inspection derivatives and raw QA swatch boards are omitted. They are not required for model build or the shipped selected-glass and Nativity-grade preparation scripts.
The nine window-preparation source photos are included. The seven sculpture originals are also included because grade_nativity_render.py hashes all seven when protecting its source chain.

Historical validation/research scripts may expect omitted reference collections, old builds or local snapshots. Rebuilding those historical audits is distinct from rebuilding the authored scene; those missing optional artifacts must not be silently presented as present.

Sculpture silhouette masks, relief fields, edge masks and all current render derivatives are included. Shallow depth/hidden sides remain interpretations; this archive does not provide full photogrammetric sculpture scans.
